metadata.description: Environment name. Used in resource names and in the environment tag.
Azure region for every resource in this deployment.
Project name. Used as a resource name prefix and as the project tag.
Value for the owner tag.
Name of the resource group to create or update.
Optional explicit suffix for globally unique names. Leave empty to derive one deterministically.
Object id of the principal that will administer Azure SQL and use Foundry. Obtain with: az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
Sign-in name of the Microsoft Entra administrator for Azure SQL.
Principal type of the Microsoft Entra administrator for Azure SQL.
Name of the model deployment created inside the Foundry resource.
Model to deploy. Verify availability with: az cognitiveservices model list --location <region>
Model version. Verify with the same command used for modelName.
Model publisher format.
Deployment SKU. GlobalStandard is the pay-as-you-go option used for v0.1.
Capacity in thousands of tokens per minute. 10 equals 10K TPM.
Name of the Azure SQL database.
Provision the built-in AdventureWorksLT sample. When false, seed with the fallback script under database/seeds/.
Minutes of inactivity before the serverless database auto-pauses. Use -1 to disable auto-pause.
Maximum vCores for the serverless database.
Expose the Azure SQL server on a public endpoint restricted by firewall rules. v0.1 needs this to reach the database from a local notebook. Firewall rules cannot be created when this is false.
Create the AllowAllWindowsAzureIps rule so Azure-hosted callers can reach the SQL server.
Single client IP address permitted to reach the SQL server. Obtain with: curl -s https://api.ipify.org. Leave empty to add no client rule.

Apply the SecurityControl=Ignore tag that exempts the SQL server from the tenant AzureSQL_PublicNetwork_Modify policy. Without it that policy rewrites publicNetworkAccess to Disabled and every firewall rule fails. Off by default because it weakens a governance control.
Provision an Azure Container Registry. Deferred to the hosted-agent release.
Provision Azure AI Search. Not used in v0.1.
Provision Foundry IQ dependencies. Not used in v0.1.
Provision long-term memory storage. Not used in v0.1.
Provision private endpoints and disable public network access. Not used in v0.1.
Provision hosted-agent-specific dependencies. Not used in v0.1.
Provision external hosting compute. Not used in v0.1.
